categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the Private Broadcast label and strengthens testing for transaction staleness in the private broadcast protocol.
categories.rationale: Strengthens fuzz testing for private broadcast transaction staleness to catch regressions that could silently abandon transactions. The description notes that mutant 3752 on MutantHub (changing `continue` to `break` in `GetStale()`) previously went undetected, meaning omitted stale transactions would never be retried by `ReattemptPrivateBroadcast()`.
